question: For $\vec{a}=\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-\hat{k}$, $\vec{b}=-3\hat{i}+\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$ and $\vec{c}=2\hat{i}-3\hat{j}-3\hat{k}$, verify that $\vec{a}+\vec{b}+\vec{c}$ is a zero vector.
explanation:
Step 1: Addition of the $\hat{i}$-components
The sum of the first components is
\(1-3+2=0\)
Step 2: Addition of the $\hat{j}$-components
The sum of the second components is
\(2+1-3=0\)
Step 3: Addition of the $\hat{k}$-components
The sum of the third components is
\(-1+4-3=0\)
Step 4: Formation of the resultant
Therefore,
\(\vec{a}+\vec{b}+\vec{c}=0\hat{i}+0\hat{j}+0\hat{k}=\vec{0}\)
Final Answer
The sum of the three given vectors is the zero vector.

options.A: $\vec{a}+\vec{b}+\vec{c}=2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}$, so the sum is not zero.
